statements.JinWishart.rectangular_det_permutation_w: {q m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin m) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℂ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin q)) : (∑ f : Fin q → Fin m, (∏ i, A (σ i) (f i))*(B.submatrix f id).det) = ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ)*(A*B).det
statements.JinWishart.det_mul_rectangular_factorial: {q m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin m) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℂ) : (q.factorial : ℂ)*(A*B).det = ∑ f : Fin q → Fin m, (A.submatrix id f).det*(B.submatrix f id).det
statements.JinWishart.gram_det_factorial_sum_square: {m q : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℂ) : (q.factorial : ℂ)*(complexGram B).det = ∑ f : Fin q → Fin m, star ((B.submatrix f id).det)*(B.submatrix f id).det
statements.JinWishart.squared_minor_le_factorial_gr: {m q : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℂ) (f : Fin q → Fin m) : Complex.normSq ((B.submatrix f id).det) ≤ (q.factorial : ℝ)*(complexGram B).det.re
